{{Quote|Artoo, you're an astromech droid. You have enough computing power to slice a triple-key, double-blind randomizer. I think you can solve a simple substitution code.|Luke Skywalker to R2-D2|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
The '''Triple-key, double-blind randomizer''' was a type of encryption device or algorithm used to encode data. It was sufficiently complex that [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] droid with powerful computing capabilities, was considered by its owner, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to be capable of bypassing its encryption.<ref name="JK" />
